WITH parsed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,config_json,CASE WHEN json_valid(config_json) THEN jsonb(config_json) END AS binary FROM fixture) SELECT id,
    CASE WHEN binary IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE WHEN json_type(binary) = 'object' THEN
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM json_each(binary) AS entry
          WHERE entry.key IN ('configuration', 'durable_runtime', 'provisioning')
          GROUP BY entry.key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ) OR COALESCE(json_type(binary, '$.configuration'), 'null')
               NOT IN ('object', 'array', 'null')
          OR COALESCE(json_type(binary, '$.durable_runtime'), 'null')
               NOT IN ('object', 'array', 'null')
          OR COALESCE(json_type(binary, '$.provisioning'), 'null')
               NOT IN ('object', 'array', 'null')
        THEN config_json ELSE json_object(
          'configuration', json_extract(binary, '$.configuration'),
          'durable_runtime', json_extract(binary, '$.durable_runtime'),
          'provisioning', json_extract(binary, '$.provisioning')
        ) END
      ELSE config_json END
    ELSE config_json END
 AS config_json FROM parsed ORDER BY id
